subject: Partner discovery: CloudForge marketplace & technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Rupa Sharma <rupa@cloudforge.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: CloudForge x Redwood — discovery recap & next steps

Hi Tessa / Camila / Marcus,

Great 30-minute intro this morning — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can align calendars: 

Summary notes (from CloudForge POV):
- Use case: CloudForge wants to surface Redwood-hosted models via our marketplace listing, with an automated provisioning flow for enterprise customers.
- Primary goals: offer a "pay-as-you-go" integration for self-serve customers, support SSO provisioning for reseller-managed accounts, and a secure route for private deployments for high-compliance buyers.
- Technical blockers identified: entitlement mapping (CloudForge IDs -> Redwood tenant IDs), billing metainfo handshake, and listing metadata requirements (icons, supported regions).

Ask / proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive (partner-led) to walk through marketplace integration APIs, sample manifest, and entitlement flow.
2) Invite internal Redwood owners: person who owns marketplace APIs, and the infra/contact for entitlement mapping.
3) Share our partner discovery brief (attached) and a draft of the integration checklist to accelerate the convo.

Proposed time slots (PDT):
- Wed 15 Mar, 10:00 - 11:00
- Thu 16 Mar, 14:00 - 15:00
- Fri 17 Mar, 09:00 - 10:00

If none of those work, our Calendly is here: https://calendly.com/cloudforge/rdw-deep-dive-45m

Attachments: cloudforge-discovery-brief.pdf (pdf) — brief with product requirements and high-level timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—Rupa
Rupa Sharma
Head of Alliances | CloudForge
rupa@cloudforge.ai | +1 415 555 0127

Thanks for the great summary, Rupa — and appreciated the clear asks. I'm looping in Camila (Partner Solutions) and Marcus (Marketplace Integrations) who will lead the technical session.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- We can do a partner-led technical deep-dive. Marcus will run the API/manifest walkthrough and Camila will cover the entitlement/billing interplay and typical marketplace UX.
- For the session, please share any sample manifests, SSO metadata, and the list of required marketplace fields you mentioned. That will help Marcus tailor the demo.

Proposed attendees from our side: 
- Marcus Lin — Senior Product Engineer, Marketplace Integrations
- Camila Reyes — Partner Solutions Engineer
- Me (Tessa) — Sales lead / agenda and success criteria owner

From your slots, Thu 16 Mar 14:00 - 15:00 PDT works best for us. I can send a calendar hold if that slot is still open. If we need to extend to 75 mins to cover integration questions, we can do that but let's start with 60.

Action items before the call: 
- Rupa: share the CloudForge discovery brief and any sample manifests (received — thanks).
- Marcus: will draft a short runbook for the demo and circulate an integration checklist template.
- Camila: will prepare a short list of entitlements questions (mapping, propagation, and lifecycle).

I've tentatively reserved Thu 16 Mar 14:00 PDT on our calendar — will convert to a confirmed invite after you ack.

Cheers,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0199

- 10-30m: API & manifest walkthrough (Marcus) — include example manifest for self-serve flow
- 30-45m: Entitlement mapping & SSO patterns (Camila)
- 45-60m: Next steps, open Qs, and owner assignment

Pre-reads I want before the call:
- Example CloudForge manifest (to validate fields)
- A sample customer flow where entitlement is provisioned (diagram or bullet flow)

Availability check: I can make Thu 16 Mar 14:00 PDT work but prefer we shift to 14:30 if that helps other attendees on the east coast. Alternatives: Fri 17 Mar 09:00 PDT (works for Marcus).

Also — tagging the internal checklist items we need to complete pre-call:
- Confirm API auth method (API key vs OAuth2 service account)
- Confirm whether CloudForge will push billing events or if Redwood should poll a billing webhook

Thanks — I will upload the draft checklist to the invite once the timing is locked.
